lead: Senior Lecturer in Computer Science with 16+ years of academic and research experience. Research interests include federated learning and its core challenges, including statistical and model heterogeneity, privacy, and explainability, with applications in medical imaging, network security, and industrial inspection. Have published in several top-tier journals and conferences. Recent work appears in Knowledge-Based Systems (Q1) and the International Journal of Information Security (Q1), as well as IEEE Access (Q2) and PeerJ Computer Science (Q2). PhD from Universiti Sains Malaysia (QS=128); research internship at OMRON SINIC X, Tokyo; research collaboration with the Jožef Stefan Institute (Slovenia); and collaboration with researchers in multiple countries, including Malaysia, Saudi Arabia, and Jordan.

bullets: Joint research on several projects, including federated learning, knowledge distillation, and trustworthy AI, with access to the institute's high-performance computing resources.

Several joint journal publications in Q1/Q2 journals, including Knowledge-Based Systems (2026, IF:8); International Journal of Information Security (2026, IF:5.0); and IEEE Access (2026, IF:4.2). Some of the papers are under review in several journals and conferences.

Designed an adaptive distillation method for decentralized (federated) learning across clients with heterogeneous data and models, using public unlabeled data; published at ICPR 2020 (Ma, Yonetani, Iqbal).
